title: Ordinary evaluation differential on one tensor summand
statement: Let X be a scheme, U an open and P,F arbitrary cochain complexes of modules on U. Let D=Hom(P,O[0]) and T=Tot(F tensor D). Suppose graded maps e from T to Hom(P,F) have the ordinary evaluation component formula [lem-pc-bounded-ordinary-evaluation-assembly]. For n+1=m, on each summand F^p tensor D^q with p+q=n, and after each Hom product projection indexed by r [lem-sc-hom-complex-projections], the composites e^n d_H and d_T e^m agree. This is a single-summand, single-projection identity, without assembling the global chain-map equation.

source.place: Tag 08DQ, ordinary complex comparison; Section 20.41, Hom-complex differential

proof.text: Expand the chosen Hom differential projection, precompose with the tensor summand and use he. Transport the projection at r+1 to its canonical degree. Apply the proved postcomposition component identity. Expand the tensor differential as the sum of d1 and d2 with Mathlib mapBifunctor.d_eq, ι_D₁, ι_D₂, d₁_eq and d₂_eq. Use he on the new summands and the signed precomposition component identity. The equality is then subtraction equals addition of a negative.
